Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you
were involved in in Baytown, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please tell me where you were headed when the collision happened.
A: I was driving home from work on a main road heading toward my neighborhood. Traffic had slowed down ahead of
me because of a light that had just turned red.
Q: What happened next?
A: I came to a stop behind a car at the light. I had my foot on the brake, and then I felt a hard jolt from behind. My car
lurched forward and hit the vehicle in front of me.
Q: Did you see the vheicle that struck you before the impact?
A: Not really. I checked my mirror a moment before I stopped, but I didn't notice anything close behind me. It all
happened very fast.
Q: Were you able to drive your car from the scene?
A: No, the front end was damaged and the car wouldn't drive safely, so it had to be towed.
Q: Did you receive medical attention?
A: Yes. I went to the emergency room that evening. They took X-rays and told me my left wrist was fractured. I've
been wearing a splint and I'm going to physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else about the collision you'd like to add?
A: Just that I was wearing my seatbelt and I was stopped completely when I was hit. I want the claim handled as
quickly as possible because I'm not able to work my usual shifts right now.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
